story: Stage 3 of the Presidential Cycling Tour of Türkiye was the first truly demanding mountain stage, featuring a summit finish. Three riders formed an early breakaway, with Remkhi being the last caught by the peloton. Inside the final 5 kilometres, Iván Sosa attacked and quickly rode clear solo. Sebastian Berwick responded and rapidly closed the gap, but couldn't catch the Colombian, finishing second and with Nicolas Breuillard coming in 3rd.
